entries.title: PostReady: PR #851 — Park the Fireflies atmosphere option (Bring to Life)
entries.description: Fireflies atmosphere overlay removed from active suite after iterative quality work. Engine preserved for future revival.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #852 — Stop carousel builder toolbar running off screen
entries.description: Carousel editor viewport overflow fixed — builder toolbar no longer runs off the screen on standard viewports.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #853 — Slim carousel top bar to four primary actions
entries.description: Carousel builder toolbar slimmed from seven actions to four primary ones — cleaner, less cluttered editor UI.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #854 — Remove duplicated chrome in carousel builder header
entries.description: Carousel builder header cleanup — removed duplicated chrome that was left over after the toolbar slim-down in PR #853.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #855 — Three-pane workspace with vertical card rail
entries.description: Carousel builder rebuilt as a three-pane workspace with a vertical card rail for easier navigation and editing.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #856 — Fix carousel rail labels and header (vs mockup)
entries.description: Two defects introduced with the three-pane change (#855): card label styles were overridden by the old rule, and the header was misaligned — caught by comparing a live screenshot against the mockup.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #890 — Landing copy: stop reading as social media manager replacement
entries.description: Landing page copy fix — page was inadvertently positioning PostReady as a social media manager replacement; repositioned to clarify its distinct value proposition.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #892 — Manual timezone override + schedule travel fix
entries.description: Fix: manual timezone override added to Schedule page; travel no longer silently shifts the schedule when crossing time zones.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #893 — Teammate invite for customer accounts
entries.description: New feature: customers can now invite a teammate onto their own PostReady account, enabling multi-user collaboration.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #894 — Carousel export size icons + download label
entries.description: Carousel export sizes now displayed as shape icons (visual); labels clarified to indicate these are download-only export presets.
